name: Joushi no Tsuma to Buka no Tsuma
source:
I like to take other people's women (things), I've been suppressing that proclivity for a long time because I had a bad experience because of it a long time ago... 

But when I is transferred to a new job, and attractive married women appear around me, this proclivity rears its ugly head again. 

One woman is the wife of my boss, who is also my boss herself. One woman is wife of the big boss. One wife is of my subordinate, who still reeks of immaturity.

The thought of corrupting these women makes me tingle and I can't stop the excitement. Now, how will I make them sleep with me?

[From [url=http://www.r18game.com/gokuraku/joshibuka/index.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
我喜欢抢走别人的女人（或东西），但很久以前曾因这种癖好遭遇糟糕经历，所以一直压抑着它……

可当我调职到新工作、身边出现迷人的已婚女性后，这种癖好再次露出狰狞面目。

其中一人是上司的妻子，而且她本人也是我的上司。另一人是大老板的妻子。还有一人是下属的妻子，身上仍带着不成熟的气息。

想到要让这些女人堕落，我就浑身发痒，兴奋得停不下来。现在，我要怎样让她们和我上床？

[来源：[url=http://www.r18game.com/gokuraku/joshibuka/index.html]官方网站[/url]]
